fields.situationSummary: Since 0900 the AODB has been feeding false gate, destination and status data to FIDS, the BHS sortation controller and the automated PA. At 1015 the PA announced "Flight 666 to Purgatory now boarding at all gates." BHS is routing all Concourse A bags to the Manual Encode pier; belts 1-3 are E-Stopped. A viral Facebook post claims ISIS has taken the control tower (false). Airlines report pilots refusing pushback because EFBs are syncing bad gate data. IT suspects unauthorized access via workstation OPS_INTERN_03 (phishing, 05/21).
fields.safetyBriefing: Crowding at airline counters, Gate C4 and the TSA checkpoint: crush risk. Manual bag handling in the BHS basement: lifting and belt-pinch hazards; lock out belts before entry. Do not trust any screen or PA message until IT verifies it.
